limits: Listeners cover initially attached actor meshes, their geometry/materials, direct textures, plain/array uniform textures and allocated skeleton bone textures.
Unattached caches, future objects, driver allocations/bytes, image closes and GPU leakage are outside this observation.
Draw callbacks are camera render submissions; they do not count unoccluded pixels. Snapshots are at native animation speed.
gpu: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (0x00002684) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
